blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
The Czarnikow London office is smaller than many people imagine. But every corner has a story. Today you learn how to describe a room. You use there is for one thing and there are for many things.

There is a reception on the ground floor. There are three meeting rooms on our floor. There is a kettle in every kitchen, and there are biscuits next to the coffee machine. There is a view of the Thames from my desk.

There are twelve brokers on the sugar desk. There is always tea at eleven, and there are plenty of plants in the office. It is a small office, but it is a happy one.

items.q: How many meeting rooms are there on the floor?
items.why: "There are three meeting rooms on our floor."

items.q: Where is the reception?
items.why: "There is a reception on the ground floor."

items.q: What can you see from the writer's desk?
items.why: "There is a view of the Thames from my desk."

items.q: The text says the office is small but happy. This suggests that…
options: the writer feels good about the office
the writer does not like the office
items.why: Inferência: "a happy one" mostra um sentimento positivo sobre o escritório.

items.q: There are twelve brokers on the sugar desk. The writer would most likely AGREE that…
options: many people work on the sugar desk
there are no desks in the office
items.why: Inferência: doze brokers é um número grande, então muitas pessoas trabalham na mesa do açúcar.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie mostrar o escritório de Londres a um visitante. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! Welcome to our London office. Come in, please. Let me show you the rooms.

This is the reception. There is one big desk here, and there are two chairs for visitors. Look — there is a window with a view of the river. It is very nice in the morning.

Now, this way. There are three meeting rooms on this floor. This one is my favourite. There is a long table, and there are eight chairs around it. There is a screen on the wall for our video calls.

Here is the kitchen. There is a kettle, and there are always biscuits next to the coffee machine. Tea is at eleven every day. Do you drink tea? Good!

And this is the sugar desk. There are twelve brokers here. It is a busy room, but it is friendly. There are plants on every desk. Is there anything you want to see? Just ask me. I am happy to help.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: How many chairs are there for visitors in the reception?
items.why: "there are two chairs for visitors."

items.q: What is on the wall in Sophie's favourite meeting room?
items.why: "There is a screen on the wall for our video calls."

items.q: What time is tea?
items.why: "Tea is at eleven every day."

items.q: Sophie says the sugar desk is "busy, but friendly". This suggests that…
options: people work hard but are kind to each other
the room is quiet and empty
items.why: Inferência: "busy" mostra muito trabalho e "friendly" mostra pessoas gentis.

items.q: How does Sophie feel about the visitor?
options: She does not want to talk
items.why: Inferência: "I am happy to help" e o tom acolhedor mostram simpatia.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "I work at a big desk near the window." A desk is…
items.why: Desk = mesa de trabalho.

items.q: "Please sit down. There is a chair for you." A chair is…
items.why: Chair = cadeira, onde você senta.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There is a big ___ in the office, so you can see the river."
items.why: Window = janela: é por onde você vê o rio.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We have a meeting now. Please come into this ___."
items.why: Room = sala: o lugar onde a reunião acontece.

items.q: "Please close the door when you leave." A door is…
options: the way in and out of a room
items.why: Door = porta: por onde você entra e sai.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no dia a dia do escritório. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Come in, please. Take a seat." Come in means…
items.why: Come in = entre, entre na sala.

items.q: "Have a look at this room. It is very nice." Have a look means…
items.why: Have a look = dar uma olhada.

items.q: "I am happy to show you around the office." To show someone around means…
options: to take them on a tour
items.why: Show someone around = mostrar o lugar, fazer um tour.

items.q: "Help yourself to a biscuit and some tea." Help yourself means…
items.why: Help yourself = sirva-se, pegue à vontade.

items.q: "Is there anything you want to see? Just ask me." Ask me means…
items.why: Ask me = me pergunte, faça sua pergunta para mim.
